Class Component3D

All Implemented Interfaces:
BranchGroupWrapper, GroupWrapper, NodeWrapper, SceneGraphObjectWrapper, LgEventSource, Component3DWrapper, LgBranchGroupWrapper
Direct Known Subclasses:
Container3D, Cursor3D, Java3DGraph, ModelLoader, NativePane
public class Component3D extends LgBranchGroup implements Component3DWrapper, LgEventSource
Component3D object is a top level object for widget development. It supports visual rendering by adding scene graph node children and event handling.
